metas.name: 1 · ★ 6.1 · 2021 · Mortal Kombat
metas.description: Cole Young, a mixed martial arts fighter marked by a mysterious symbol, is pulled into a hidden war between Earthrealm and Outworld, where ancient warriors must unite before a devastating invasion begins.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 2021 · Mortal Kombat Legends: Battle of the Realms
metas.description: The Earthrealm heroes must journey to Outworld and fight for the survival of their homeland, invaded by the forces of evil warlord Shao Kahn, in the tournament to end all tournaments: the final Mortal Kombat.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Mortal Kombat II
metas.description: The fan favorite champions -- now joined by Johnny Cage himself -- are pitted against one another in the ultimate battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.
